about: How Illuminator (mosaik) scenario YAML model types appear in the diorama. 'asset' = key in library.json. 'role' = producer | consumer | storage | hub | unknown (used by the auto-layout). 'hidden' = not drawn (data sources). 'repeat' = name of a parameter that gives the number of copies (e.g. houses: 5). 'power' = the outputs that carry power in kW: a YAML connection from such an output becomes an energy flow; 'dir' is 'out' (energy goes the way of the connection) or 'in' (the other way, e.g. demand), 'signed' = a negative value reverses the flow, 'kind' = flow colour (diorama.js FLOW_KINDS). A type without 'power' turns every monitored output that is connected to another drawn model into a flow. 'port' = where flows attach on the model (node port_<name>; default port_main or the top). 'level' = an output in % shown as a fill bar (battery state of charge). 'grid' on a hub = add a grid connection that closes the hub's power balance (positive = import).
